Coram : N.V. RAMANA, MOHAN M. SHANTANAGOUDAR, AJAY RASTOGI
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 – Or. VIII, r. 6A – Filing of counter-claim by defendant after submitting written statement – Embargo on, if any – Respondent No.1 filed suit for specific performance against the petitioner statement – Thereafter, filed counter-claim – Trial court rejected the objections on filing of the counter-claim after filing of the written statement and framing of issues – High Court quashed the counter-claim – Petitioner approached the Supreme Court –
Decision Date : 19-11-2019 | Case No : SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 23599/2018 | Disposal Nature : Reference answered | Bench : 3 Judges
